rows.what_the_ink_shows: Beside the circled 3, both the source and target A have a closed, rounded lower-case a subscript, and the arrow is labelled E^{n-2i}; the target superscript is n-i (crops/14_scan112_L274_map.jpg). Below the map, ‘injectif exc. p’ is crossed by a continuous horizontal line, ‘bijectif’ is inserted above it, and the following ‘mod groupes finis’ is uncancelled (crops/14_scan112_L274_bijectif.jpg). Thus the manuscript itself explicitly reads the quoted bijectivity claim with a subscripts.
rows.note: Written: A_a^i(X) --E^{n-2i}--> A_a^{n-i}(X), ‘bijectif mod groupes finis’. The supplied correction disputes this formulation for cycles modulo algebraic equivalence and proposes a statement for rational cycles modulo homological equivalence, with a claimed relation to the Lefschetz standard conjecture. That is a mathematical objection/refinement, not a paleographic correction, so preserve the written map and the author's own replacement of injectif by bijectif. The cited Griffiths/Clemens results and the supplied equivalence claim were not independently verified; this review settles the ink only.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Visually collated the full scan and two separate enlarged contrast-raised crops. Confirmed a subscripts, the arrow exponent, the deletion of injectif exc. p, and the inserted bijectif followed by uncancelled mod groupes finis. No mathematical proof check, external literature verification, or other-page inspection was performed.

main_reader_review: Inspected both a subscripts, the E exponent, and the cancellation/insertion sequence. Accepted b; retained the author's inserted bijectif and uncancelled mod groupes finis, without endorsing unverified literature claims.
